I'll look through the notes folder first so the filenames and index match what's actually there.The minutes use seven different name styles. I'll rename them to `YYYY-MM-DD.md` by the date each meeting was held, and add an index.The minutes in `notes/` now share one filename pattern, and `notes/index.md` lists them in date order.

Each file is `YYYY-MM-DD.md`, using the date the meeting was actually held. The 25 August meeting is `2026-08-26.md` because it was moved a day for the storm. The note text is unchanged.

| Was | Now |
| --- | --- |
| `aug11.md` | `2026-08-11.md` |
| `minutes 25 aug.md` | `2026-08-26.md` |
| `Meeting sept 8.md` | `2026-09-08.md` |
| `notes_2026-09-22.md` | `2026-09-22.md` |
| `oct6 meeting notes.md` | `2026-10-06.md` |
| `2026.10.20 minutes.md` | `2026-10-20.md` |
| `Nov 3 (final).md` | `2026-11-03.md` |

The index is a table of those seven meetings with a one-line note of what was decided at each.

I'll standardize the notes folder filenames and create an index.Reading the notes and README to understand the current naming conventions.Planning to standardize file names and add an index to the notes folder.

The files currently use inconsistent formats. The ISO date style is already present. I will standardize all names to that format.

The August 25 file should be renamed to 2026-08-26 to match the actual meeting date. The planned ISO format is YYYY-MM-DD.md.

All seven files are now mapped to their correct ISO dates. The final choice is between `YYYY-MM-DD.md` and `minutes-YYYY-MM-DD.md` for the index.

The chosen format is `YYYY-MM-DD.md`. The index will be `notes/index.md`, listing each meeting with date, link, and summary. `members.csv` will be left untouched.

The index will list meetings oldest first. Each entry will include the date, minutes file, and a one-line summary.No other references to the specific filenames were found.

I'll rename all notes to `YYYY-MM-DD.md` based on the meeting date in each file. I'll create `notes/index.md` as the index. ISO 8601 dates sort correctly and match the existing file that already used that style.

The `notes_` prefix will be dropped since the files already live in the notes folder. The August 25 file will be renamed `2026-08-26.md` to match the actual meeting date. The index will list dates, links, attendees, and one-line decisions without rewriting the minutes.

The index will be a three-column markdown table. It lists the date, the renamed file, and a one-line summary of each meeting's decisions.

The index now covers the final four meetings: the September 22 roof quote, the October 6 and 20 work orders, and the November 3 year-end wrap-up.

I considered adding a one-line pointer to the index in the root README, but decided against it. The user asked to tidy the notes folder specifically, so I will leave the root README unchanged.Renaming files and writing the index.The root README indicates the notes/ folder contains minutes.
